**Adaptation boundary:** Fused weights are read from the pinned MLCommons TFLite artifact and loaded into the equivalent PyTorch DS-CNN inference graph. The fixed EEMBC INT8 MFCC examples are dequantized with the source model input parameters.

## How to Run

```bash
# one-time asset preparation
uv run mlperf fetch --workload keyword-spotting --profile max

# benchmark run (writes JSON/HTML/CSV reports + .provd provenance)
uv run mlperf run --workload keyword-spotting --profile max --open-report

# quick smoke pass
uv run mlperf run --workload keyword-spotting --profile min

# research envelope
uv run mlperf run --workload keyword-spotting --profile pro
```

See the [running guide](../../guide/running.qmd) for profile semantics, report handling, and power measurement flags.

## Candidate Quality Target

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Metric** | top1_accuracy |
| **Target** | 0.9 |
| **Direction** | higher |
| **Target basis** | mlcommons_derived |
| **Tolerance** | 0.0 |
| **Reference runs** | 0 |

**Reviewer notes:**

- The 90% threshold and 1,000-example MFCC evaluation contract are inherited from MLPerf Tiny.
- Promotion requires a committed multi-run performance sweep and independent review of the TFLite-to-PyTorch adapter.
- Each execution performs 1,000 untimed accuracy-set passes to establish a repeatable device state, then measures 2,000 unchanged passes; quality is computed from the first measured pass only.

## Systems Experiment Execution Contract

**Within-run measurement protocol:**

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Primary metric** | inference_seconds |
| **Scenario** | offline |
| **Timing scope** | 2,000 repetitions of the complete 1,000-example accuracy set after model, data, and the declared 1,000-pass device warmup are complete |
| **Included phases** | batched PyTorch model execution |
| **Excluded phases** | asset fetching, TFLite weight parsing and PyTorch model construction, data-file loading and INT8 input dequantization, 1,000 untimed complete accuracy-set passes after one shape warmup for each observed batch shape, accuracy computation, checkpoint, report, and provenance serialization |
| **Device synchronization** | synchronize immediately before and after the measured inference region |
| **Outer reference runs** | 5 |
| **Outer preconditioning runs** | 0 |
| **Outer inter execution cooldown seconds** | 5 |
| **Repeatability metric** | inference_seconds |
| **Repeatability limit** | 0.05 |
